name: European bison
desc: Europe's heaviest land animal eats grasses, herbs and tree bark and leaves. The forest holds the largest free-living herd, restored after reintroduction in 1929.
about: The European bison (pl.: bison) or the European wood bison, also known as the wisent, the zubr (), or sometimes colloquially as the European buffalo, is a European species of bison.
